chapter: Hite tours, postwar L.A. and the Central Avenue scene
title: Meeting Evelyn, the singer, in the Hampton band
summary: His wife Evelyn Meyers sang on a poorly recorded side; they married years later.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: On the tune, on that particular session, the tune -- my wife, who was the vocalist in the band, Evelyn, she sang a tune called "I Nearly Lost My Mind" on one of the records, which was very, very badly recorded, wrong tempo, wrong key, wrong everything. It wasn't a good recording at all and didn't do her justice at all.
Was she listed as Evelyn Royal?
How long had you been married then?
Oh, I see. You married her after that.
Yeah, that's how we met, in the Basie Band -- in the Lionel Hampton Band.
Oh, so that was -- did you get married during the time you were with the band or --
No, no, no, no, no, way later. Way later, down the line.
How much further down the line?
